relationships.evidence_quote: desensitize TRPV1 in primary sensory neurons

key_findings: Thiophene replaces the cyclohexyl motif in SAFit-type FKBP51 inhibitors while retaining selectivity over FKBP52, via a flipped-out Phe67 conformation.
Compound 19b binds FKBP51 in cells, desensitizes TRPV1 in primary sensory neurons and has acceptable mouse PK.
